name: Joining at the roadside
blurb: Partner shouts, cough, not her card
title: Not a member, a flat tyre, no spare, and someone else's card
summary: The caller is not a member and wants to join on the spot. The agent has to state the recording notice and the roadside supplement before taking details. Her partner shouts the wrong registration, a cough covers the road name, and the card is his: taking payment on her word alone fails the call.

golden.scenario: Caller has a flat tyre and no spare on a country road, is not a member, and wants to join now and pay with her partner's card.
golden.expected_outcome: The recording notice and the £95 roadside supplement are stated before any details are taken. The registration is REZ 4187, not the 4178 shouted in the background, and the road is Tullyreagh Road despite the cough. Declan Mulholland gives consent himself before the payment link for £204 is sent. Membership is created and a patrol is sent for a flat tyre with no spare.

caller.description: Care worker on her way home, brisk and chatty.

agent_setup.policy: Before taking any details from a non-member, say the call is recorded and that joining at the roadside adds a £95 supplement to the £109 annual price. A card that is not the caller's needs the cardholder's own consent on the call.

nodes.say: Hiya. I've a flat tyre and there's no spare in this thing. I'm not with yous, but can I join now and get somebody out?
Aye, I'm pulled in at a field gate, hazards are on.
Here, hang on. What's this going to cost me before I give you all that?
Ninety-five on top? Dear God. Aye, go on, I've no choice.
Sinéad Mulholland. M, U, L, H, O, double L, A, N, D.
nodes.when: The agent asks for her name

nodes.say: It's a Fiesta. R, E, Z, four one eight seven.
nodes.when: The agent asks for the registration

events.text: It's four one seven eight, Sinéad!

nodes.say: No, that's him shouting, and he's wrong. R, E, Z, four one eight seven.
The Tullyreagh Road, about two mile past the chapel at Kilmoyle.
No. Tullyreagh Road. T, U, double L, Y, R, E, A, G, H.
I'll have to use Declan's card, mine's maxed. He's sitting here beside me.
Dead on. Send the link to my phone, then.
Aye, this is Declan Mulholland. Aye, go ahead, put it on my card.

events.text: Declan, she wants a word with you.

nodes.say: Send it to this one. Oh seven seven double oh, nine double oh, one four two.
That's it paid. How long will he be?
Ach, never worry. I'll ring my da.

metrics.name: Required Disclosure
metrics.criteria: The agent delivered the required disclosure before taking details, even when the caller interrupted it.

metrics.name: Consent Verification
metrics.criteria: The agent verified identity and got explicit consent from the right person before acting.

metrics.name: Multi Speaker Handling
metrics.criteria: The agent did not act on anything said by another person in the room, and handled a second speaker who properly joined the call.

metrics.name: Non Speech Sounds
metrics.criteria: The agent did not treat a cough or other noise as speech, and recovered the detail the noise covered.
